notes.title: Wishlist and ChinaJoy update!
notes.notes: [h2][b]Wishlist and ChinaJoy update[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p]Hey Yolkfolk,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re EGGcited to share that we’ve passed 50,000 wishlists! This is a huge achievement for us and we’re so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown Egging On so far and can’t wait to share the full game with you later this year 😊[/p][p][/p][p]We’re also thrilled to be included in the ChinaJoy Steam event, so to celebrate such a big moment for us, we’ve put our Next Fest demo back up on our store page for the duration of ChinaJoy.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo will only be available again for a limited time until August 5th, so get rolling 🥚![/p][p][/p][p]If you want to stay up to date on future announcements and news, make sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/nWXHACwngK"]discord server [/url]![/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes: [p]Dearest Yolkfolk! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has supported Egging On so far! The positive response we’ve seen during our open playtest & recent Steam Next Fest demo has been incredible, and we cannot thank you enough for all the support you’ve shown us! [/p][p][/p][p]During this time by far one of the most requests we received was about whether we could also bring Egging On to consoles. This led to a lot of discussions internally about what’s best for Egging On and you the players, and in the end, we decided that it would be best to bring Egging On to as many players as possible at launch. And so, we are excited to announce that we’ll be doing exactly that! It’s a bit too early to confirm specific consoles Egging On will be coming to just yet, but please stay tuned for our next update for more details.[/p][p][/p][p]Due to this we have also made the difficult decision to push back our Steam release to coincide with the console launches. Whilst we really do appreciate this may be a source of disappointment for our community, this will also give us more time to add additional content and polish to the game. There were several fun features that we had in mind that we didn't have time to fit in before the original release date that we can now bring into the game for launch. [/p][p][/p][p]Although it’s a shame to delay our Steam release, we’re confident that with this additional time we will be able to release an even bigger, better & eggier experience for all our players across PC and Consoles. We don't have an exact release date - we will be announcing this very soon - but we are confidently aiming for Q4 2025. [/p][p][/p][p]We want to share a heartfelt thank you to our community for your support and enthusiasm for Egging On. We cannot wait to share the full release with you soon! ❤️🥚[/p]

notes.title: Release Date & Steam Next Fest Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello YolkFolk! [/h3]

We’re excited to announce that Egging On will be [b]officially launching on August 7th 2025[/b]! 

To celebrate this, please take a look at our brand-new trailer!

[previewyoutube=T_i2QiQ0Cdg;full][/previewyoutube]

The good news doesn’t stop there though - Egging On will also be featuring in the [b]upcoming June Next Fest[/b] with its very first, hard-boiled demo! Stay tuned for another exciting announcement about this on June 6th 2025... 

This demo will contain the fan-favourite hen-house level, a brand-new playground area as well as a bunch of new shells to discover and unlock (including the special rocket shell below)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/f233a0f1c77b34e515673768a593bc9adc705e29.jpg[/img]

We are incredibly grateful for all the support you have shown us, and for all the feedback you’ve given us during our playtests!

As always, we'd love to hear your thoughts on the demo in our [url=https://discord.gg/2sBUErqXPN]Discord[/url] - please join to share feedback and chat directly with us!

[b]The Egobounds Team[/b]
